input: Find a local grief support group to attend

gold.taskTitle: Find and Attend a Local Grief Support Group
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and join a grief support group available in their local area.

questions.title: What type of loss are you grieving right now?
questions.description: Understanding whether the loss is a spouse, parent, child, friend, pet, or other helps identify the most relevant and specialized support groups.

questions.title: What city or zip code are you located in?
questions.description: A specific location is needed to search for groups that are physically accessible to the user.

questions.title: How recently did your loss occur?
questions.description: The recency of the loss may determine which type of group is most appropriate, as some groups are designed for acute grief and others for longer-term processing.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person meetings or would virtual work?
questions.description: Knowing the user's preference for format helps narrow the search to groups that match their comfort level and availability.

questions.title: Are there days or times that work best for you?
questions.description: Scheduling constraints will determine which groups are realistically attendable for the user.

questions.title: Do you have a preference for a faith-based or secular group?
questions.description: Some grief support groups are rooted in religious frameworks while others are entirely secular, and this is an important fit factor.

questions.title: Have you tried any grief support resources before?
questions.description: Knowing what the user has already attempted helps avoid repeating unhelpful suggestions and builds on what has or has not worked.
